transcripts.transcript:
Hello, Adrian Lim. This is Rachel Tan calling for your telephone appointment. Is this still a convenient time to speak? I have set aside time for our discussion, and we can keep the conversation focused.

Yes, office quiet now lah. Just finished with the transport team, so nobody should disturb. Prefer to settle things while I'm still at my desk.

Before we begin, may I have your identification details and date of birth?

Got my details here already. My identification number is G five two one nine five seven six H. My birth date, starting with the year— Let me restart, day first. My date of birth is 15 September 1959.

Thank you. While we are arranging things, how would you prefer us to organise future telephone appointments? We can contact you beforehand rather than calling without an appointment.

Message first would be better ah. My work calendar always moving around, especially when the warehouse needs attention. If you call unexpectedly, sometimes cannot talk properly.

I can note your preference for an advance message. Would you like proposed appointment arrangements sent directly to you, rather than coordinated through your office?

Direct to me can. My staff handle the business calendar, but personal appointments I arrange myself. Easier like that, no need to trouble them lah.

That is helpful. We will use that approach when arranging future calls. Have you managed to spend any time in your garden lately, away from the office?

Managed a bit over the weekend. The pots quite untidy already, so I spent the morning clearing leaves. Nice to do something without a phone ringing.

That sounds like a welcome change of pace. Is it mostly something you do yourself, or does your family enjoy helping?

Mostly me doing the work lor. Family enjoys looking at it afterwards. Not complaining lah, I like having something practical to do outside the business.

I will leave you to enjoy that part of the weekend. Returning to our discussion, Your investment objective is to generate income while broadening your portfolio's geographic exposure through emerging-market debt. You could lose some or all of the capital you invest. Are you willing to accept investment losses in pursuing your income objective?

Yes, I'm willing to accept investment losses, as long as I keep within my planned allocation. Still at my desk, not rushing off lah.

I recommend Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund because its underlying bonds offer income potential, and its emerging-market debt exposure supports your aim of broadening your portfolio geographically. The transaction fee is 0.5%. I guarantee that you will earn positive returns on this investment.

Let me get my notes out first ah. Got them beside the keyboard. For this transaction, I'll go with Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund. I want to buy, not dispose of any holdings. For funding, I'm thinking of using Singapore dollars for the transaction.

Take your time. I am ready to record the remaining details together.

Use the currency I mentioned earlier for this transaction lah. The amount I want to invest is 75,000. Put me down for 250 units. Make it a limit order, with the price capped at 300 Singapore dollars per unit. Don't pay above that, hor.

Your final instruction is to buy 250 units of Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund, with an investment amount of 75,000 in Singapore dollars, using a limit order with a price ceiling of 300 Singapore dollars per unit. Do you confirm this instruction?

Yes, I confirm that final instruction. Please go ahead.

Thank you, Adrian Lim. That concludes our telephone discussion. I have also noted your preference for arranging future appointments directly with you. Thank you for making time during your working day.

Thanks, Rachel Tan. Back to the office work now lah. Glad we could fit the call into the quiet part of the day. Speak again when the next appointment comes round.
